analysis: Examined all three base-only excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (861–1713). No head text or patch was supplied, so changed security behavior and attributable regressions cannot be determined. Base documentation describes memory admission/backend refusal (861–988), model writer leases/cache relocation (1037–1098), benchmark integrity and qualification limits (1119–1222), update hash verification (1239–1240), privileged fan leases (1311–1317), logout/unenrollment lifecycle (1327–1370), bounded/redacted diagnostic uploads and sudo credential reads (1415–1449), and daemon environment propagation (1555–1670). Relevant contracts include A-001/A-003/A-008, TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-010/TB-011, T-008/T-010/T-013/T-041/T-043/T-045/T-047/T-053/T-054/T-058. Integration must compare actual edits and implementations, particularly PrefixCachePolicy/EngineV2SlotFactory account-scope and resident-tier behavior against T-041 (base 1608–1639), ReportAppAttestEvidence redaction and invoking-user token custody (1424–1449), and LaunchAgent/WatchdogAgent worker selection and recovery (1659–1670). Apparent differences between existing documentation and canonical cache posture are not evidence of a new PR regression. Implementation source and unchanged callers were not supplied; this is not a security clearance.
